title: Pisces: the gift that means the most
old_caption: Pisces doesn't need anything expensive. A few honest lines in someone's own handwriting will be kept for years. If you love a Pisces, write it down.

title: Pisces: one word for the new year
old_caption: Pisces, your word for next year is ground. Keep dreaming, just with your feet in the snow. A dream with roots is one you can actually live.

title: Here for the snacks (and maybe love)
old_caption:
Taurus walked into the confessional for the crackers and walked out with a crush.
Who else showed up for the food and stayed for the person?

title: Aries waited four whole minutes
old_caption: Four minutes without a reply and Aries came through the curtain. One text back and suddenly the most patient sign alive. Tag your four-minute friend.

title: Gemini booked the booth twice
old_caption:
One Gemini is so over them. The other one kept the napkin. Turns out both of them like them, which is a first.
Which side of you is winning today?

title: Cancer still has the hoodie
old_caption: It's not a hoodie, it's a whole museum with plaques. Cancer misses who they were in it, and folds it into the give-back box anyway. What's in your ex museum?

title: Leo posted it for one viewer
old_caption:
The selfie was for nobody. The refreshing was for one person. Leo's new plan: skip the post, just say hi.
Be honest, who was your last story for?

title: Virgo brought a binder
old_caption: Three tabs, two appendices and a pressed flower, and the conclusion page is still blank. Virgo's answer was never going to be in the binder. Who needs to hear this?

title: Libra minded. A lot.
old_caption:
"I don't mind" three times on a date, then one full scream into a cushion about noodles. Practise it with Libra: I'd love noodles.
What do you actually want for dinner?

title: Scorpio is fine. Totally.
old_caption: Scorpio said fine five times and the lower third stopped believing it. The real answer took one question, and then a call to the best friend on the boom mic.
